correctness.rationale: PASS: Facial distance is the minimum Euclidean separation from every nonempty proper face F to the convex hull of complementary vertices. The coordinates fixed to 0/1 give face parameters (a,b,r,j), and averaging closest pairs by within-block permutations is valid for convex sets under a common compact symmetry group. Every outside vertex incurs at least one unit of violation mass, u+v>=1; the block norm bound is u²/a+v²/b+(u-v)²/r. The equality witness is an actual convex combination of outside vertices whose one wrong fixed coordinate is uniformly distributed. This gives squared distance n/[n(a+b)-(a-b)²] for every positive-dimensional face; vertex distance n/[k(n-k)] is strictly larger for k,n-k>=2. Strict improvement as b increases and strict concavity in a imply H and exactly the claimed minimizing orbit pairs; explicit integer maximization independently checked all n=4..30 and 2<=k<=n-2 (378 rank cases). Source verify.py exact rational orbit witnesses and numerical QP are supporting finite checks, not proof for arbitrary n. All boundary n=4,k=2 and transition n=4t and 4t+1 agree.
